about_blocks.text: Breakthrough Recovery Centre is a private residential treatment centre for addiction and mental health at 135 32nd Street North in Wasaga Beach, Ontario. It opened in 2026, is run by Breakthrough Recovery Centre Corp, and takes adults 18 and over, men and women, from across Canada. The building is a white two-storey house set among tall trees, a short walk from the Georgian Bay shoreline. Admissions lines are open around the clock, and the team aims to admit people within 24 to 48 hours of the first call.

It opened in 2026, is run by Breakthrough Recovery Centre Corp, and takes adults 18 and over, men and women, from across Canada. Admissions lines are open around the clock, and the team aims to admit people within 24 to 48 hours of the first call.

about_blocks.text: Most people start with the Harbour Program, the centre's on-site medical detox, then move into a residential stay of 4, 6 or 8 weeks. Detox runs under physician oversight with nurses on hand, and the team can manage withdrawal from alcohol, opioids, benzodiazepines, prescription drugs and stimulants. Anyone who needs hospital-level care is referred to it instead.

about_blocks.text: The program treats addiction and mental health together. Anxiety, depression, trauma, PTSD, burnout and emotional dysregulation are treated as part of the work, and the centre also takes people whose main problem is gambling, compulsive sexual behaviour or problem gaming, with no substance use required. A trauma specialist is on staff. Days mix individual therapy, group work, psychoeducation and skill building with gym time, recreation and sober activities in the community.

about_blocks.text: Families have two routes in. Bridge Sessions are therapist-led family sessions during the stay, and Circle of Healing gives one loved one private therapy of their own. Visiting is on Sundays once the client is ready.

about_blocks.text: Planning for home starts early. The Compass Pathways program covers housing, work, education and budgeting before discharge. Graduates can join a weekly Zoom aftercare group and keep a weekly check-in with their counsellor for up to a year through the Anchor program. Treatment is private pay and not covered by OHIP, though the centre offers instalments and provides receipts for extended health claims.

centre.faq_heading: Frequently Asked Questions About Breakthrough Recovery Centre

faqs.question: Is Breakthrough Recovery Centre open and taking admissions?

answer_blocks.text: Yes. Breakthrough Recovery Centre opened in Wasaga Beach in 2026 and marked its grand opening with the Town of Wasaga Beach in August 2026. Admissions answers the phone 24 hours a day at (705) 352-9600, and the centre says it aims to admit people within 24 to 48 hours of first contact.

Admissions answers the phone 24 hours a day at (705) 352-9600, and the centre says it aims to admit people within 24 to 48 hours of first contact.

faqs.question: How much does Breakthrough Recovery Centre cost?

answer_blocks.text: The centre does not publish its prices. Fees depend on which program and how many weeks you choose, and admissions gives you the cost in writing before you are admitted. It is private pay, so OHIP does not cover it, but you can pay in instalments and use credit card, debit, money order or cash. Card payments carry a processing fee.

answer_blocks.text: Residential stays run 4, 6 or 8 weeks, called the North Star, Guiding Light and Lighthouse programs. The centre's FAQ also mentions a 12-week option, so ask admissions if you think you need longer. Your length of stay is agreed after a clinical assessment.

faqs.question: Does Breakthrough Recovery Centre offer detox?

answer_blocks.text: Yes. Medically supervised detox, called the Harbour Program, happens on site under physician oversight with nursing care, and you move straight into residential treatment once you are stable. It covers alcohol, opioids, benzodiazepines, prescription drugs and stimulants. People who need hospital-level medical or psychiatric care are referred elsewhere.

faqs.question: What does Breakthrough Recovery Centre treat?

answer_blocks.text: It treats alcohol and drug addiction, behavioural addictions such as gambling, compulsive sexual behaviour and problem gaming, and mental health concerns including anxiety, depression, trauma, PTSD and burnout. Dual diagnosis is a main focus, and you can be admitted for a behavioural addiction or a mental health concern without any substance use.

faqs.question: Where is Breakthrough Recovery Centre and how do I get there?

answer_blocks.text: The centre is at 135 32nd Street North in Wasaga Beach, Ontario, a few steps from the Georgian Bay shoreline. It is about an hour and 45 minutes north of Toronto by car and around 40 minutes from Barrie. If you are flying in, admissions can arrange a driver from the airport, though you pay for the ride.

answer_blocks.text: Some extended health plans cover part or all of residential addiction and mental health treatment, so call your insurer first and ask about inpatient care.
